BL-1548 — start_handoff_daemon.sh honours SWARMFORGE_SKIP_DAEMON=1 before its audit machinery exists, so a skipped start request leaves no line in daemon-start-audit.log and the line's own SKIP_DAEMON= field can only ever read empty; audit the invocation first, then skip (still starting nothing, still not re-arming the stopped marker), and add the drift wiring test's case 05 proving the drift-repair bounce reached the launcher
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored and one production script changes, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: under SWARMFORGE_SKIP_DAEMON=1 the launcher still starts nothing and still exits 0, and it still does NOT clear the freshness stopped marker (a skipped star…
BL-1548 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1548" (or "reject BL-1548 <reason>") to act.
